design_gotchas.title: Pin-Identical 2 A Sibling of TPS563201DDCR — Verify Current Limit & Inductor Sizing
design_gotchas.detail: TPS562201DDCR shares the exact SOT-23-6 pinout, 0.768 V VFB, 580 kHz D-CAP2 control, 17 V VIN max, and 1.5 MOhm EN pulldown with 3 A TPS563201DDCR, making it a strong cost-down candidate below 2 A. However, its higher-RDS(on) 140/84 mOhm FETs, lower 2.4 A min OCL (vs 3.3 A min), and larger recommended inductors (3.3 uH at 3.3 V, 4.7 uH at 5 V vs 2.2/3.3 uH) must be verified before downgrading a 3 A rail.

design_gotchas.title: 17 V Max Input (19 V Abs Max) Fails on 24 V Rails Built for Pin-Identical TPS54202/TPS54302
design_gotchas.detail: TPS562201DDCR uses the same SOT-23-6 pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=VFB, 5=EN, 6=VBST) as TPS54202DDCR, TPS54302DDCR, and AP62200WU-7, but its 17 V max VIN (19 V abs max) and 7.0 V max VOUT cannot survive 24 V industrial buses. Furthermore, its 0.768 V VFB causes +28.9% overvoltage if dropped onto a 0.596 V TPS54x02 divider without recalculating resistors.

design_gotchas.title: Floating EN Disables TPS562201 (Internal 1.5 MOhm Pulldown) — Opposite of TPS54202 & AP62200
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike float-to-enable TPS54202DDCR, TPS54302DDCR, and AP62200WU-7, TPS562201 integrates a 1.5 MOhm (600-2400 kOhm) pulldown on EN (Pin 5), so leaving EN floating holds the converter permanently OFF. Conversely, EN is rated to 17 V rec / 19 V abs max and may be tied directly to VIN.

design_gotchas.title: Incompatible Pinout vs AP63300/AP63203 and D-CAP2 75% Duty-Cycle / Cout Bounds
design_gotchas.detail: Do NOT confuse TPS562201DDCR with Diodes AP63300WU-7 or AP63203WU-7 (which use 1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST). Also obey D-CAP2 ceramic Cout bounds (20-68 uF per Table 7-2) and the 75% max recommended duty cycle (VIN_min >= VOUT / 0.75 per Section 7.3).

typical_use_cases: 5 V or 12 V adapter/bus step-down to 1.05 V, 1.8 V, 3.3 V, or 5.0 V at up to 2 A continuous load
Cost-optimized D-CAP2 fast-transient point-of-load supply for set-top boxes, routers, DTVs, and cameras
Compact 580 kHz SOT-23-6 Eco-mode buck with minimal external components and 1.0 ms internal soft-start
engineering_summary: The TPS562201DDCR is a 4.5 V to 17 V input, 2 A continuous synchronous buck converter in SOT-23-6 (DDC) using TI's D-CAP2 control with Eco-mode pulse skipping (580 kHz typ, 140/84 mOhm FETs, 120 uA Iq, ~93% peak efficiency at 5 V). It is the pin-compatible 2 A sibling of TPS563201DDCR and shares the SOT-23-6 pinout of TPS54202DDCR/TPS54302DDCR/AP62200WU-7 (NOT AP63300WU-7/AP63203WU-7), but engineers must respect its 17 V VIN / 7.0 V VOUT ceilings, 0.768 V feedback reference, 20-68 uF Cout window, and internal 1.5 MOhm EN pulldown (must be pulled high to start). Always verify divider ratios and transient margins against the official TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 confirmed DDC 6-pin SOT-23-THIN Top View pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=VFB, 5=EN, 6=VBST) with no exposed pad.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max VIN/EN/SW 19 V, Rec Op VIN 4.5-17 V, TJ -40 to 125 C, RthetaJA 90.8 C/W, and RthetaJC(top) 42.3 C/W.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.5 verified TPS562201 IQ 120 uA typ (200 uA max), REN 1500 kOhm pulldown, VFBTH 768 mV CCM / 774 mV Eco, RDS(on) 140/84 mOhm, Iocl 3.2 A typ (2.4 A min), and Fsw 580 kHz.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 confirmed SLVSD91D (Sep 2024) revision, VOUT 0.76-7 V, and TPS562201 Efficiency plot peaking ~93% at VOUT = 5 V.
